title: Battle of Krtsanisi
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Krtsanisi", at revision 1379001086, opens: "The Battle of Krtsanisi was fought between the army of Qajar Iran (Persia) and the Georgian armies of the Kingdom of Kartli-Kakheti and Kingdom of Imereti at the place of Krtsanisi near Tbilisi, Georgia, from September 8 to September 11, 1795, as part of Agha Mohammad Khan Qajar's war in response to King Heraclius II of Georgia’s alliance with the Russian Empire. The battle resulted in the decisive defeat of the Georgians, capture, and complete destruction of their capital Tbilisi, as well as the temporary absorption of eastern Georgia into the Iranian empire." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2615347, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1795 part of Persian invasion of Kingdom of Kartli-Kakheti". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
